description.value: Donair Affair is a donair-focused restaurant on Grandview Highway in east Vancouver, serving the Canadian-style spiced meat sandwiches that have become a staple of the city's diverse food scene. The spot offers indoor seating in a smoke-free environment, making it a sit-down option for cyclists passing through the commercial strip. Its presence on a delivery platform suggests it also handles takeout orders.
